description: Check a trial balance before closing or reporting. Send up to 200 accounts, each with its name (or a GL code of up to 6 digits in a row), its type (asset, contra_asset, liability, contra_liability, equity, contra_equity, revenue, contra_revenue, expense) and its debit or credit balance. Get back whether total debits equal total credits and the difference, every account carrying the opposite of the normal balance for its type (an overdrawn bank account, a credit balance in an expense), totals by type, net income from the revenue and expense lines, and, when it is out of balance, the classic places to look: a difference divisible by 9 (swapped digits), an account equal to half the difference (posted on the wrong side) or to the whole difference (entered twice or one side missing). Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/trial-balance-check). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

account.description: Account name or GL code (up to 6 digits in a row), your own text, echoed back.

credit.description: Amount in this column (0 or more; leave out if none).

debit.description: Amount in this column (0 or more; leave out if none).

type.description: Account type: asset, contra_asset (accumulated depreciation, allowance), liability, contra_liability (bond discount), equity, contra_equity (draws, dividends, treasury stock), revenue (send gains here), contra_revenue (returns, discounts), expense (send losses and cost of sales here).

label.description: Optional label for the trial balance (your own text, echoed back).

name: trial_balance_check
